NetBird | Berlin, Germany | ONSITE & Remote for some roles | Full-time | https://netbird.io

We build open source secure remote access for teams and infrastructure. 25k+ stars, Series A. Our mission: make secure connectivity simple and accessible for everyone.

Looking for people excited about the product, startup pace, and growth. Actively hiring for:

- Senior Backend Engineer (Go, networking, distributed systems) (Onsite)

- Staff Software Engineer (Go, systems design, scaling)

- Engineering Manager (leading teams, dev productivity, scaling eng org, IC is a plus)

- Head of Growth (PLG, dev tools, OS motion, conversions and funnels)

- Product Marketer (IT/dev audience, positioning, content & GTM strategy)

- Solutions Engineer (customer-facing, highly technical, bridge product & users)

You’ll be working on modern networking infrastructure and helping shape both the product and the company.

Please email me at: veronica.external@netbird.io and connect with me on Linkedin (if you have) at https://www.linkedin.com/in/veronicaroman718/

We are actively hiring and will respond to all applicants.

To see more roles not listed here: https://careers.netbird.io/
